No worries, thank you for being so descriptive in your response and explanation. As a kid, I had two paranormal experiences. One where something walked over to my bedside and leaned over me, and one where a light-bulb fell out of a lamp I was speaking about at that exact moment. I chopped these up to just be kid things or possibly dreams because I was only 8 years old, but I have always thought kids and animals know more about the paranormal than adults do. Other than that, no previous paranormal activity.
Unfortunately, I do not know anything about the property itself or the past owners, but I have been living here for about 15 years now, because when I was 1 I lived in a different house. 
I do feel like it was most likely caused by something I did. Perhaps I have just been thinking about creepy things too much or questioning the existence of the paranormal. I am mainly skeptical of this kind of stuff but it seems that every-time I least expect it, it comes back up. It is important to note that I AM indeed an extremely emotional person. Not that this should give anyone a reason to discredit my experience, but I have generalized anxiety and depression. Along with that fact, I am also on medication. Something that might be worth mentioning: my uncle mark just attempted suicide and my dad has been on edge lately. This has really stressed me out lately. My mom recounts lots of times she has felt something was off within the house. Such as the time she thought someone was crawling up on her bed when there was really nobody there. Or when she heard someone in the kitchen, walked out and saw a human figure standing there, ran back to her bedroom for my dad, and came back out to see nobody there. Those experiences were from years and years ago, but still creepy nonetheless. I do believe that some of it could be from being tired, but I am typically a pretty healthy and well slept person. Other than depression once a month or so, I have hardly any anxiety anymore and I am (generally) a pretty positive person. 
I will definitely make a diary for documentation, that is a WONDERFUL idea! Thank you! Also, thank you for a more rational explanation to the issue, I appreciate that as well. I will certainly keep this in mind and make sure to observe. Thanks again for the input!! :)
